review_kind: pinned-source-only geometry audit; no real transform parameters or manuscript arrays inspected
actual_point_map: F(x) = A x + b + d_TPS(x); TPS displacement is evaluated on the input x and added in the output frame.
not_the_same_map: A (x + d_TPS(x)) + b is different in general and is not what the inspected function implements.
actual_normal_expression: normalize(A n), implemented by apply_affine_vectors(..., normalize=True)
actual_use: e_n_tgt is passed as the slab sampling direction. Integration must first choose whether to preserve a transported source ray or construct a perpendicular target sheet normal.
geometric_sheet_normal: normalize(J_F(x)^(-T) n); equivalently normalize(cofactor(J_F(x)) n) when det(J_F)>0.
transported_ray_or_tangent: J_F(x) v, followed by normalization only when a unit direction is desired; this is not a target sheet normal in general.
positive_similarity_caveat: For a positive similarity without a varying nonlinear residual, A n has the same direction as the geometric inverse-transpose result. No anisotropic/sheared actual affine or nonzero actual angular error was established.
derivative_omission: The inspected normal/ray code does not differentiate the TPS displacement. Whether its derivative is materially nonzero at any actual sampled location was not measured.
unit_contract: The new helper requires consistently handed orthonormal Cartesian physical frames in micrometres for input and output. An anisotropic voxel point map requires explicit source and destination physical-scale wrappers and physical-coordinate source normals.
scope_limits: The new helper is standalone; Gemini code and existing frozen files are unchanged.
Generated geometry accuracy does not establish manuscript registration accuracy, correct sheet identity or ink improvement.
A fitted map can contain noise; differentiating that fit correctly does not make it a correct physical deformation.
Positive local determinants and step checks do not certify global injectivity or absence of unsampled folds.
